TrustWorx / Singularity

One AI estate. One governed path. One continuous loop.

Singularity is the operating platform for enterprise AI. It brings every agent, model and tool into one view, runs every request through the same policy-enforced path, and turns what happens into evidence and improvement. Any model, any cloud, any agent.

Request a briefing →See how it works →

Enterprise AI went from pilots to production all at once.

Agents moved into every function in under two years, but the safeguards, visibility and economics never caught up. The gap shows up as shadow AI, unmanaged cost and compliance exposure.

What is actually running? — Nobody has the map. Most enterprises can't name every agent, model and tool live in their business, or who owns each one.

What is it costing? — Spend outruns oversight. Token cost compounds across teams with no attribution, routing or budgets. Finance can't see it, let alone contain it.

Can we prove it's compliant? — Risk grows unmeasured. The EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and sector rules demand inventory, evidence and safeguards, with real penalties.

Four forces are turning AI governance from optional to urgent.

Shadow AI and a new attack surface

Unsanctioned copilots touch sensitive data. Prompt injection and leakage are board-level risks.

AI cost is scaling non-linearly

Token spend compounds across teams with no attribution, routing or budgets.

Regulation has arrived

The EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and sector rules now demand inventory, evidence and safeguards.

Boards want accountability

Leaders must prove AI is safe, compliant and worth the spend, with numbers, not assurances.

You can't govern what you've never mapped, sensed, directed or proven. Governance-first tools skip the early steps, so they stay dashboards.

Map · Sense · Direct · Prove · Evolve.

Five actions, run in order on one governed path. A loop that never stops.

ActionCoversWhat it does
1 · Mapthe AI estateScan, classify, register and flag every agent, model, tool and workload, including shadow AI and EU AI Act risk tier.
2 · Sensewhat is happeningReal-time telemetry, correlated across systems, users and workflows to detect anomalies, drift and emerging risk.
3 · Directwhat should happenRoute, enforce policy and supervise the plan in-path, on a unified context layer of identity, data, activity and policy.
4 · Provewhat happenedMeasure quality, cost and outcomes with full lineage, so audit is a by-product of every run.
5 · Evolvewhat happens nextGuardrail events and results feed back into policy and routing, so the estate gets safer and cheaper.
  1. Identity and trust
  2. Pre-check
  3. Planner
  4. Grounded knowledge
  5. Model router
  6. Tool boundary
  7. Verifier
  8. Audit and evidence

One request, one governed path. Nothing reaches a model or a system of action without passing through, so governance can't be bypassed and what happens flows straight back into the loop.

Five outcomes, one platform

Visibility

One live registry of every agent, model, tool and workload, with owner, data touched and lifecycle state.

Governance

Policy enforced in the execution path, including sovereignty rules that keep regulated workloads in-region.

Economics

Cost attributed by team and use case, with routing to the cheapest model that still clears the quality and risk bar.

Trust

Tamper-evident lineage and framework-mapped evidence packs for auditors, on demand.

Progress

Evaluation and regression guards, so changes are tested before they reach production.

Delivered with partners

Lands through systems integrators and telecom partners, inside the estates teams already run.

Anticipated impact

2–5× faster time to value
20–40%lower AI operating cost
50%+reduction in AI risk exposure
3×higher productivity with trusted, AI-native workflows

HOW WE DELIVER

From first conversation to production

  1. Foundation

  2. Build and validate

  3. Scale and embed

    Expand to more teams, monitor cost and quality, and hand over a roadmap for enterprise scale.
